`context.go` holds `ClientIP()`, which picks the client address. `gin.go` holds the trusted-proxy CIDR list, the header validation, and the default `RemoteIPHeaders` (`X-Forwarded-For`, `X-Real-IP`). `docs/doc.md` documents the trust model, and `CHANGELOG.md` records the security fixes behind it. `logger.go` only consumes `ClientIP()` for logging.

The client IP is resolved in `ClientIP()`. It trusts the remote address only if it falls in the configured trusted-proxy CIDRs, then walks `RemoteIPHeaders` (default `X-Forwarded-For`, then `X-Real-IP`) from the right and returns the first address that isn't a trusted proxy. `TrustedPlatform` (e.g. `CF-Connecting-IP`, `Fly-Client-IP`, `X-Appengine-Remote-Addr`, or a custom header) is checked first and returned directly. Unix-socket listeners are always trusted. The default trusted set is `0.0.0.0/0` and `::/0`, so every proxy is trusted until `SetTrustedProxies` narrows it.
